name: Zapata Quantum, Inc.
summary: Zapata Quantum, Inc. functions as an enterprise primarily focused on generative artificial intelligence. The company's core strength lies in applying sophisticated data science and engineering principles to create robust, industrial-grade solutions. It was established in 2017 by Christopher Savoie, Alan Aspuru-Guzik, Yudong Cao, Jonathan Olson, Peter Johnson, and Jonathan Romero-Fontalvo, and its main office is located in Boston, Massachusetts.
